get.description:
REQ-BROWSE-1: open in every phase, including before the cycle opens.
REQ-BROWSE-2: keyword, school, topic and supervisor filters, combined with AND, case-insensitive.

REQ-PROJ-4: the admin sees every project and where it stands, drafts and closed ones included. Read only. Students
still see published projects only (REQ-BROWSE-3). Published first, then drafts, then closed; by title within each.

schema.title: Response Admin Listings Admin Listings Get

get.description:
REQ-BROWSE-4: published projects that fit the student, best first, each with a score and its reasons.
Only during an application window, when a student can act on them: not before the cycle opens, in the
pre-application period, between rounds or after the cycle.
Empty when the student has no research interests yet, or cannot apply this cycle (placed or ineligible).
Projects already applied to or with no open slot are left out.
Picker for proposals (REQ-PROPOSE-2): active supervisors only, sorted by name.

schema.title: Response My Listings Supervisor Listings Get

post.description:
REQ-PROJ-4: a closed project goes back on Browse for the open cycle, with its content kept. Only while a cycle is
open, from its pre-application period to its closing date. The slot count restarts from this cycle's accepted
students, so last cycle's students do not fill it.

Closing hides the project from students and keeps its matches. Applications still under review are withdrawn
(a closed project cannot be matched), each affected student's remaining preferences move up, and they are told.
Upload or replace a listing's cover image. Changing the cover is an edit, so REQ-PROJ-2 applies.
Add a photo to the listing's gallery (lab, equipment, sample results). Same rules as the cover.

get.description: Only this cycle's proposals: when the cycle ends, the list is empty and the next cycle starts clean.

schema.title: Response My Proposals Me Proposals Get

post.description: The student takes back a proposal the supervisor has not answered yet. Once it is accepted or declined it is final.

get.description: Only this cycle's applications: when it ends, the list is empty and the next cycle starts clean.

post.description: Tips on a draft application before it is submitted (REQ-APPLY-4). Saves nothing and never shows a score.

schema.title: Response Applicants Supervisor Listings  Listing Id  Applicants Get

post.description:
Fit score and reason for each applicant this round (REQ-VRANK-1). Gemini when GEMINI_API_KEY is set, else local.
Only the listing's own supervisor: the scores are built from applicants' personal data (SRS 5.3.3).

schema.title: Response Ai Match Supervisor Listings  Listing Id  Applicants Ai Match Post

get.description: How much each factor counts in this project's AI match (REQ-VRANK-5). Students never see these.

Returns a 10-minute signed URL for the in-app PDF viewer (REQ-VRANK-3).
url is null when no file was ever uploaded for the document.
Cycle history, newest first, so admins can browse past cycles (REQ-CYCLE-1).

schema.title: Response List Cycles Admin Cycles Get

post.description:
REQ-CYCLE-1, use case 1-1. One cycle at a time: the next one can be created once the current one has closed,
and creating it moves that one to the history. A cycle cannot be closed early; to end it sooner, an admin moves
its closing date (REQ-CYCLE-2).

put.description:
REQ-CYCLE-2, 3: change the cycle's dates. Rounds that have not started move with the opening date and the
pre-application window, keeping their spacing (NFR 5.4.3).
REQ-ROUND-1..3, use case 1-2: replace the rounds and keep the cycle's dates.

Use case 1-1 step 5, 1-2: Cycle settings sends the cycle's dates and its rounds in one request, so they are
checked as one schedule and either all of it is saved or, if a check fails, none of it.

get.description:
REQ-REV-1 "Unmatched": students who applied in this round and hold no match, so an admin can assign them
(REQ-ASSIGN-1). The same set as the summary's unmatched count.

schema.title: Response Unmatched Students Admin Rounds  Round Id  Unmatched Get
Response Matches Admin Rounds  Round Id  Matches Get

post.description:
REQ-ASSIGN-3, use case 1-6 E1: take a student off a project so they can be assigned elsewhere.
The match is removed; the audit entry keeps who did it, when, and why (REQ-AUDIT-1).

get.description:
REQ-AUDIT-1, newest first. Entries are never changed (REQ-AUDIT-2); readable names for the records they
affect are added to the copies sent out.

schema.title: Response Audit Log Admin Audit Get
Response Supervisor Matches Supervisor Matches Get

get.description:
Use case 3-3 step 3: the profile and application of the student proposed for the supervisor's project.
`application_id` is empty when the URECA office assigned the student without an application.

post.description:
REQ-APPRV-2, 4: during the approval window a supervisor may decline a student matched to their project.
Matches they leave alone are offered when the window closes; there is nothing to approve.

get.description: The student's latest match result: in the active cycle, or in the latest cycle once every cycle is closed.

schema.title: Response My Match Me Match Get

post.description:
Called by Vercel Cron daily at 5:05 pm SGT, just after windows open and close, and whenever an admin opens
Matching Rounds. In Supabase mode this is what moves the schedule. Unlike keep_schedule, a failing step fails this
call, so the cron log shows it.

get.description:
Search by code prefix ("SC40") or title words ("deep learning"),
or look up exact codes ("SC4001,SC3020") to show their titles. Unknown codes are left out.
Current API time. `enabled` is false when DEBUG_CLOCK is off, so the UI can hide itself.

put.description: Freeze the API clock at the given moment. Applies to every user, on every API process, until reset.

delete.description: Go back to the real clock (or the fixed demo clock in mock mode), for everyone.

ActiveItem.title: ActiveItem
ActiveItem.description: Something that is still open for a user, shown before an admin deactivates them or changes their role.

ApplicantScore.title: ApplicantScore
ApplicantScore.description: AI match fit score for one applicant (REQ-VRANK-1). source says whether Gemini or the local formula scored it.

ApplicationTips.title: ApplicationTips
ApplicationTips.description: Advice for the student. Never a score.

ApplicationTipsRequest.title: ApplicationTipsRequest
ApplicationTipsRequest.description: A draft application to check before submitting (REQ-APPLY-4). Nothing is saved.

CleanupWarning.title: CleanupWarning
CleanupWarning.description: The 409 `has_active_items` body: nothing was changed. Resend with confirm_cleanup=true to close these first.

ClockState.title: ClockState
ClockState.description: Debug clock (developer tool). `enabled` is false when the server has DEBUG_CLOCK off.

FitParts.title: FitParts
FitParts.description: How a recommendation's score is made up (REQ-BROWSE-4). Maximums: 50, 30, 20.

PreferenceRankingUpdate.title: PreferenceRankingUpdate
PreferenceRankingUpdate.description: Ordered application ids, most preferred first (REQ-SRANK-1, 2).

RoundsUpdate.title: RoundsUpdate
RoundsUpdate.description: Admin defines up to three sequential rounds (REQ-ROUND-1).

ScheduleUpdate.title: ScheduleUpdate
ScheduleUpdate.description:
Use case 1-1, 1-2: the cycle's dates and its rounds, checked as one schedule and saved together or not at all.
A date left empty keeps its current value.

ScoreEvidence.title: ScoreEvidence
ScoreEvidence.description: Why a score is what it is (REQ-VRANK-4). From Gemini, quote is checked word for word against source.

ScoreWeights.title: ScoreWeights
ScoreWeights.description:
How much each factor counts in a project's AI match, in percent (REQ-VRANK-5).
The router checks they total 100, each at least 5. The default is an equal share.

TranscriptParse.title: TranscriptParse
TranscriptParse.description: What was read from an uploaded transcript. Empty values mean not found; nothing is saved (REQ-PROF-1).

Window.title: Window
Window.description: What a user may do right now. Computed by services/windows.py.
